proposition: The R. Suʾl al-Mulūk was written in or before 829/1426 at Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh's request as an introductory work on both the practical-magical (alchemical, talismanic) and theoretical sides of lettrism, giving a broader overview than his other lettrist treatises.
